description: Source code for PEM (Privacy-Enhanced Mail) encoding and decoding functions, including a PEMTokenizer class for parsing PEM blocks and a PEMEncode function for encoding data into PEM format.

classes.name: PEMTokenizer
classes.description: A class for parsing PEM encoded blocks from a string.

classes.name: PEMTokenizer::PEMType
classes.description: A struct representing a PEM block type with its header and footer strings.

methods.name: PEMTokenizer::PEMTokenizer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the tokenizer with a string and allowed block types.

methods.name: PEMTokenizer::GetNext
methods.description: Parses and retrieves the next PEM block from the input string.

methods.name: PEMTokenizer::Init
methods.description: Initializes the tokenizer with the input string and allowed block types.
